details.completeness_justification: All nine key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. Each criterion's core material meaning is present, with supporting sentence IDs identified. The summary captures revenue change, gross profit increase, operating profit improvement, net profit growth, EBITDA growth, cash flow improvement, current ratio improvement, geographic sales breakdown, and product category performance—all without material omissions affecting the overall understanding.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. There are no self-contradictions: statements about revenue decline (S2) are consistently followed by explanations of improved profitability through cost reductions (S5-S6, S8). All comparisons (period-to-period, product-group) are logically connected. The structure follows a clear sequence: revenue -> cost/profitability -> cash flow -> balance sheet -> key ratios. While there is a minor numerical discrepancy between total revenue (€52.064m) and the sum of specified product group sales (€49.17m), the candidate does not present these as exhaustive additive components of the same total, so this does not constitute an internal contradiction under the specified accounting safeguard. No unnecessary repetition materially reduces clarity. The summary forms a coherent narrative from top-line performance to profitability, cash flow, and balance sheet developments.
